additional_concerns: Both candidates convert preservation of an application's existing processing route into a change-level exclusion from relief. That interpretation is plausible for the pending application, but the source does not establish a continuing exclusion after withdrawal, disposal or replacement.
Both candidates test pending status at 28 November 2025. The transition provision does not expressly specify when absence of approval or authorisation must be tested.

The source states both “will take immediate effect” and “will take effect on 28 November 2025 (Effective Date).” The explicit implementation date supports the encoded threshold, but the relationship between those statements and the legally relevant assessment event remains unresolved.

The geographical scope and UK UCITS classification match footnote 1. Home-jurisdiction compliance, novelty, complexity and possible local policy implications remain supplied classifications rather than implemented legal determinations.
Neither supplied dependency ID identifies its external material, and both have null source hashes. No FAQ, forms, checklist or existing-process mapping can be inferred.

The missing FAQs prevent confirmation of operational completeness; their absence does not establish an omitted substantive eligibility condition. False results do not establish an approval duty, and true results do not establish overall compliance.
